_comment: Image modality registry for run_together: `type` -> its default colorize hex (`color`) and `kind`. kind=single is a colorized single-channel layer (its `color` is overridable per image); kind=rgb is a multi-channel passthrough (e.g. H&E) with no color. An optional `defaults` object supplies per-image fields for the type (same vocabulary as an --images row; an explicit row value wins). Edit this file to add or adjust image types; keys beginning with '_' are ignored.
